summary: Began implementing a Pi extension UI bridge by adding new protocol schemas (bumping protocolVersion to 20), creating a new PiExtensionUiRuntime module that maps Pi's extension UI callbacks to typed wire requests and emits setStatus/setTitle/setWidget/setEditorText/notify events, and wiring the runtime into the agent service's session activation flow alongside session entry types.
decisions: Bumped protocolVersion from 19 to 20 to introduce new extension UI request/response and event schemas (no client migration discussed).

Modeled the bridge as a per-session PiExtensionUiRuntime that owns a random runtimeId, pending request map keyed by requestId with AbortSignal + optional timeout, and dispatches select/confirm/input/editor as request envelopes while treating notify/setStatus/setWidget/setTitle/setEditorText as fire-and-forget events.
Stored the runtime on the ActiveSession record (extensionUi field) so each session has an isolated runtime that is cleared on session disposal.
errors: Initial introspection command attempting to resolve the impeccable scripts context module failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND; the agent fell back to reading the reference docs directly.
